title: Skippy Cellar Sub
description: A dark, dry square sub-bass pulsing a skippy 2-step garage figure, gated by a tremolo that doubles then quadruples across the loop. Over 16 cycles a euclid/ply stepped re-trigger thickens the groove while the lowpass tightens, the timbre dirties with stepped crush/coarse, and a fast nervous tremolo bites in — all kept sub-deep and dry.
code:
setcpm(130/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 ~ [c1 g0] c1 ~ [eb1 c1] g0 c1>*2").s("square")
    .attack(0.002).decay(0.11).sustain(0.45).release(0.03)
    .penv("<7 12 5 9>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.04)
    .lpf(saw.slow(13).range(620, 240)).resonance("<5 8 11 7>/16").ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv("<2 3 5 4>/8").lpattack(0.003).lpdecay(0.08)
    .ply("<1 1 2 1 2 4>/8")
    .mask("1 1 1 0 1 1 0 1".euclidLegato("<5 6 7>/16", 8))
    .tremolosync("<4 8 16>/8").tremolodepth(saw.slow(23).range(0.55, 0.9))
    .crush("<16 16 10 8 6>/16")
    .coarse("<1 1 2 1 4>/8")
    .shape("<0.15 0.25 0.35 0.2>/8")
    .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3).hpf(420).coarse(2))
    .gain(0.95)
)
